paragraphs: Better Impact sells volunteer management software used by organizations to automate scheduling, track hours and communicate with volunteers. A membership product manages member profiles, automates renewals and supports engagement across the member lifecycle. A client product works alongside the volunteer system to coordinate volunteer and client interactions.

Coordinators get self-scheduling, automated communications, online training modules and one-click reports. The broader promise is streamlined scheduling, less administrative burden and hour tracking in one system. A separate offering called Volunteer Link is built for corporate social responsibility teams that want to engage employees, strengthen community partnerships and measure impact. It gives employees access to over 200,000 volunteer opportunities across the US and Canada. Reports come export-ready for ESG disclosures, board presentations and annual CSR summaries.

The company says more than 85,000 organizations use its software. Its published case studies include a hospice rethinking how it coordinates care. In March 2026 it announced the acquisition of Get Connected by Galaxy Digital, another volunteer management software provider. Leadership is listed as chief executive Houston Goodwin and president Tim Sarazen.

quote.text: Automate volunteer management from recruitment to reporting
